summary: Resolved part of the RequestAddNode documentation-status limitation. Added a documentation source range and a fact recording that basis, extended the interpretation's source_ids, and rewrote the limitation to state which captured text is contradicted while leaving the choice between changing the comment or the guard as a product decision.
